summary: Digi International Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a $350 million senior secured revolving credit facility with BMO Bank as administrative agent, amending and restating its prior December 2023 credit agreement. The facility matures August 27, 2031, includes an accordion feature enabling additional borrowing capacity, a $10 million letter-of-credit sublimit, and a $10 million swingline sub-facility. Pricing ranges from 1.25% to 2.625% over Term SOFR depending on leverage. Proceeds fund permitted acquisitions and general corporate purposes. This is a routine refinancing of existing credit facilities, not a special situation.
